workingTree: dirty; current Release stabilization batch including thumbnail virtualization

protocol.isolation: fresh settings and caches per launch; no concurrent Excise testhost
protocol.viewMode: single after open; opening initially renders the default continuous mode
protocol.paging: 30 view-model page-index changes at the existing runner cadence, approximately 3.6 seconds; W9 is a small-form floor without paging
protocol.timedSamples: two 45-second idle intervals after waitIdle; actual elapsed time comes from the monotonic journal
protocol.diagnostics: boundary footprint/ps/vmmap, in-process managed heap and viewer cache bytes, metrics trim/reclaim events
protocol.bookDump: dotnet-dump collect --type Heap after the 90-second sample; no gcdump or forced GC; final diagnostic window in this measured run was 30 seconds, extended to 45 seconds in the checked-in protocol

samples.reason: deactivated at approximately 27 seconds; SoftTrim intentionally stops the idle timer; one deactivation background trim occurred

bookNativeAt90Seconds.attributionLimit: VM_ALLOCATE includes runtime/native mappings; this region category is not a retained object or allocation-stack owner. A managed dump cannot assign the native remainder to one renderer cache.

tracedOwners.rootSuffix: PdfViewerControl -> ContinuousPageView -> DecodedImageSampleRetention -> retained PdfStream -> System.Byte[]
DocumentSession -> ServiceProviderEngineScope -> DocumentTextIndexSession -> DocumentTextIndex -> per-page IndexedWord arrays

bookManagedDump.interpretation: The entire managed object walk is approximately 51MiB, not a 100MB recoverable managed allocation. The non-collecting GC.GetTotalMemory(false) samples are estimates and differ from the later object walk. No individual native retained owner was proven in this pass.

decision: Keep the already-merged immutable-image-sharing fix. No new renderer, allocator or cache-policy fix is justified by this one-run attribution pass. The custom drawing/owned-buffer rewrite remains #1926, which is deferred.
limitations: One repeat per document; no calibrated noise floor; these are observations, not improvement claims.
Current managed Release differs from the historical shipping AOT build and rapid in-process paging differs from keystroke paging.
W9 had no idle reclaim and cannot serve as a confirmed post-reclaim comparison floor.
The metrics recorded only one single-page render duration in each run; page-turn p95 and scroll-hitch acceptance are not established by this protocol.
Preview was not measured; the 2-3x Preview bar and a new 100MB reduction on both documents are not established.

Physical footprint fell substantially between 45 and 90 seconds while managed committed and viewer cache bytes stayed unchanged. That is consistent with allocator/OS decay, but a region category alone is not proof of one native owner.
Raw dumps and personal PDF fixtures are local evidence and are not versioned or redistributed.
